_comment: MagiSentry hook for Claude Code. Drop into .claude/settings.json (project-local) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). Intercepts pip/npm/yarn install Bash commands and routes them through `magisentry` so the 7-layer scan runs before the package is ever fetched. If `magisentry` exits 2 (threat) or 1 (technical failure in fail-secure mode), the original Bash call is blocked. Exit 0 lets the original command proceed.
